entries.subject: DAMIT 3529: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-3529.txt. Model 3529, version 2019-05-07, pole (131°, -54°), period 9.47747 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: The retained calibration uses 47.78 ±2 km. mean radiometric diameter from IRAS flux-based albedo and H
